b1-unit-21.21.1 One backpack:
Bruno: Wow, your bed is covered in clothes. Are you taking all that?
Danny: No way. I'm only taking one backpack. I'm going to Patagonia for two weeks, and then to Buenos Aires.
Bruno: So you need clothes for hiking and for the city. Let me help. What's this?
Danny: My long black waterproof jacket. That goes in, for sure. My mom says I should wear layers: a T-shirt, a warm sweater and a jacket on top.
Bruno: And this ugly old green wool sweater?
Danny: Hey! It's my favorite. I found it at the second-hand store for twenty reais.
Bruno: OK, OK. What about shoes? You can't hike in those sneakers.
Danny: I know. I've got a pair of brown leather hiking boots. I'll wear them on the bus, so they don't take up space in my bag.
Bruno: Smart. And for Buenos Aires? You're going to a tango show, right? You can't go in hiking boots.
Danny: Ha! I'm taking a light blue cotton shirt and my dark jeans. Do you think that's smart enough?
Bruno: It's fine. But take off that cap when you go in. And you need a nice belt.
Danny: I don't have a belt.
Bruno: Take mine. It's a classic brown leather belt. Here, try it on... See? It fits.
Danny: Thanks! OK, what else? Socks, underwear, a swimsuit for the lakes, a hat and some gloves.
Bruno: Gloves? In December?
Danny: It's summer down there, but it can get cold in the mountains, especially at night.
Bruno: Fair enough. Now fold everything neatly and roll the T-shirts. They take up less space that way.
Danny: Yes, sir! Hey, can you help me close the backpack? I think I'll have to sit on it.
